title: digitalis canariensis f. glaberrima
intro: Digitalis canariensis f. glaberrima, commonly known as the Canary Island Foxglove, is a plant species within the Digitalis genus, characterized by its foxglove-like flowers and glabrous leaves. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of cardiovascular conditions, such as atrial fibrillation and congestive heart failure, due to its ability to strengthen heart contractions and improve heart rate. The therapeutic actions of Digitalis canariensis f. glaberrima are attributed to its digitalis glycosides, which have cardiotonic and vasodilatory effects, thereby improving cardiac function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various cardenolides, such as digoxin and digitoxin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
